objective: Build a provenance-controlled general-language, code, model-architecture, and engineering-acceleration corpus with an explicit token-to-parameter budget.

coding_target.rule: Open an extension tier only after the smaller matched model fails a frozen capability gate.

ratio_contract.measurement: tokenizer-native non-padding tokens after splitting, including EOS

mix.role: English fluency, narrative structure, and anti-forgetting replay
source-code structure, API documentation, identifier usage, and execution-oriented constraints

languages.name: rust
content: The Rust Book and language reference

languages.name: cpp
content: selected permissively licensed documentation and source files

mix.role: architecture names, components, training objectives, and model-family comparisons
topics: flow matching and diffusion language models

mix.role: compiler, GPU kernel, operating-system, profiling, and systems terminology

systems.name: linux
content: scheduler, memory, I/O, tracing, and eBPF documentation

rules: No unlicensed source may enter training.
Conditional-license material stays separately indexed and is not redistributed with the package.
Model weights are a derived artifact, not permission to redistribute source text.
Every source manifest is reviewed before tokenization.

cleaning_policy.secret_scan: quarantine files matching private keys, access tokens, or credential patterns
code_filters: cap repeated boilerplate and license headers
documentation_filters: remove navigation, cookie banners, and repeated site chrome
preserve headings, code fences, formulas, and API signatures
retain source URL and revision for every document

split_policy.unit: source snapshot, repository file, or document family

curriculum.goal: stable token prediction and language coverage

curriculum.data: all families at the frozen target mix
curriculum.goal: retain broad language quality and prevent domain collapse

promotion_gates.source_integrity: Every training token traces to a hashed source record and an explicit license.
promotion_gates.split_integrity: No exact or near-duplicate content crosses train/validation/test.
promotion_gates.tokenizer: The tokenizer is fitted on train only and has a frozen hash.
promotion_gates.mixture: Every declared family has its planned token share, and code covers Python, Rust, and C++.
promotion_gates.contamination: Public benchmark tasks are quarantined before tokenization.
promotion_gates.claims: A mixed-corpus gain is not claimed until the matched arm comparison is complete.

current_seed_corpus.scope: general-language seed only; not yet a mixed-corpus experiment

evidence_boundary: This config defines acquisition, mixing, and parameter-budget policies. It contains no mixed-corpus quality evidence.
